data.name: Skyfell Mutation
data.detailed_description:
"Embrace Your Mutation"

The world as we knew it has ceased to exist. A meteorite brought with it the "Distortion"—an organic plague that transforms cities into living labyrinths and people into grotesque monsters. You are one of the infected, but you have managed to curb the infection. Your hand has become the key to survival and evolution.

Game Features:

Dynamic action shooter: Combine classic gunplay with the destructive abilities of your mutated hand. Draw enemies in, create organic shields, or unleash deadly spikes—your body has become a weapon.

Evolution Tree: Absorb the genetic material of fallen enemies and the power of meteorite fragments to unlock new development branches. Customize your abilities to suit your playstyle, from brute force to cunning range control.

Earth's Distorted Beauty: Explore locations where familiar urbanism intertwines with alien flora. Abandoned megacities overgrown with carnivorous vines, and quiet suburbs turned into mutant lairs.

Unravel the mystery of the disaster: Every note, every trace in the location brings you closer to the truth. What did the meteorites bring? Why didn't your hand kill you, but gave you power? The answer awaits at the very center of the Distortion.

data.short_description: Skyfell Mutation - this is a dynamic action shooter set in a biological post-apocalypse. Explore an Earth devastated by meteorite impacts, where flora and fauna have been transformed into deadly mutants. Develop supernatural abilities and try to unravel the mystery of civilization's demise.
